Home.heroTitle: Turning every plant into a story, a supporter, and a step toward saving Finnish flora.
Home.heroLead: Adopt a plant. Save a species. Welcome to the University of Oulu Botanical Garden.

Plants.indexDesc: Every plant in the outdoor garden and the Romeo & Julia greenhouses has its own page, its own audio narration, and — for many — a sponsorship invitation.
Plants.searchAria: Search plants by common name, Latin name, or family
Plants.noMatchHint: Try a different name or clear the filter.

Adopt.title: Adopt a plant
Adopt.cardSubtitle: Visa · Mastercard · FI online banks · Apple/Google Pay
Adopt.name: Name (optional)
Adopt.corporateBlurb: CSR-ready quarterly impact reports, logo placement on greenhouse signage, private event slot for up to 20 guests. Tax-deductible under TVL §57 for Finnish corporates.
Adopt.localPerks: All physical perks — postcards, prints, books, seeds — come from Finnish artists, presses, and the Garden's own seed bank.
Adopt.pickPlantHint: Some plants are nearly fully funded — co-adopt anyway, or pick one that needs you more.
Adopt.personaliseHint: For yourself, a friend's birthday, in someone's memory, or for your class.
Adopt.publicDedication: Public dedication (shown on plant page, optional)
Adopt.iahBlurb: Pair your adoption with a plant from your home region. An emotional anchor for far-from-home visitors. Included in every tier at no extra cost.
Adopt.giftWrapHint: Printed certificate on linen card stock, mailed to recipient
Adopt.memorialBlurb: Plaque-text remains on the plant page for 5 years. We'll email a chosen family member each spring on the bloom anniversary.
Adopt.memorialOfPlaceholder: Person being remembered (shown on plant page)
Adopt.coAdoptHint: Split the gift; everyone gets named on the plant page.
Adopt.marketingOptIn: I'd like quarterly email updates about my plant and the Garden's conservation work. Max 2/month, no third parties (GDPR-compliant).
Adopt.refundsPolicy: Donations non-refundable except for technical errors.
Adopt.plantDiedPolicy: Plant-died policy: replacement in year 1, transfer to equal/higher rarity in years 2+.
Adopt.taxDisclosure: Of €{total}, €{donation} is treated as a donation (no VAT); €{benefits} covers benefits (24% VAT applied). This gift may be tax-deductible for Finnish companies under TVL §57.

MeProfile.title: Account settings
MeProfile.lead: Update what we show on your certificates and how we email you.
MeProfile.nameHelp: Shown on receipts, plaques, and the donor wall (unless you opt out below).
MeProfile.homeRegionHelp: We try to pair you with a plant from your region. Optional.
MeProfile.dataLead: GDPR Article 15 & 17. We respond within 30 days.
MeProfile.exportNote: A signed link will be emailed within minutes.
MeProfile.eraseNote: An admin reviews each request. Finance records remain for 6 years per Finnish accounting law.

Staff.title: Operations dashboard
Staff.lead: Quick links to AdminJS for the resources your role can touch.
Staff.cardCatalogueDesc: Add or edit plants, accessions, citations, images, audio narrations.
Staff.cardRagDesc: Re-ingest documents, review off-base answers, edit curator notes.
Staff.cardFinanceDesc: Payments, receipts, tax certificates, bank-reconciliation upload.
Staff.cardAdoptionsDesc: Cancel adoptions, mark plaques installed, manage gift codes.
Staff.cardUsersDesc: Promote staff, deactivate accounts, review audit log.
Staff.cardSettingsDesc: Translations, email templates, feature flags, VAT, system settings.
Staff.cardAuditDesc: Every mutation, signed-in or system-initiated. Append-only.
Staff.denied: This page is for Garden staff. Sign in with your University of Oulu account or ask an admin to grant you access.

bankInstructions.title: Complete your donation by bank transfer
bankInstructions.openBankApp: Open your banking app and create a SEPA payment with these details. The RF reference lets the Garden reconcile your donation automatically — no further action needed from you.
bankInstructions.qrCaption: Open your bank app's camera and scan to pre-fill the transfer.
bankInstructions.nextSteps: Once the Garden's accountant receives your payment (usually within 2 business days), you'll get a PDF receipt by email and your plant will show up in 'My Garden'.

Ask.title: Ask the Garden
Ask.subtitle: Curious about a plant? Our garden answers, drawing on real records from Oulu's living collection and Finnish flora research.
Ask.placeholder: What do you want to know about our plants?
Ask.noAnswer: I don't have a confident answer for that. Would you like me to forward it to a curator?
Ask.introSignedIn: Your conversations are saved to your account, so you can revisit them any time from your Garden.
Ask.introAnon: Ask one question to try it. To save your conversation and revisit it later, sign in. It's free and takes 10 seconds.
Ask.signInToSave: Sign in to save your conversations
Ask.offTopic: I can only help with questions about plants, our garden, and Finnish conservation. Try one of the suggestions on the left.
